vanilla_effect: 1 in 4 chance for each played 8 to create a Tarot card when scored (Must have room)
plus_effect: Each played 8 has a 1 in 4 chance to create a Tarot card or a 1 in 4 chance to create a Spectral card when scored (never both; Must have room)
impl_notes: context.individual + G.play, other_card:get_id() == 8, and a free consumable slot (#G.consumeables.cards + G.GAME.consumeable_buffer < card_limit, like vanilla). One roll decides both outcomes so they can't both happen: p = num/den from SMODS.get_probability_vars(card, 1, extra.odds, 'bplus_magic_8_ball', true) (so Oops! All 6s counts); any = min(1, 2 * p); u = pseudorandom('bplus_magic_8_ball'); u < any/2 -> Tarot, any/2 <= u < any -> Spectral. Tarot and Spectral stay equally likely even when Oops! pushes the total to 1. Add the result to SMODS.post_prob the way SMODS.pseudorandom_probability does, so 'probability rolled' effects still see it. Create with create_card('Tarot' / 'Spectral', G.consumeables, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, '8ba'), using consumeable_buffer.
acceptance_tests: ["Seeded run, score many 8s with free slots -> Tarots and Spectrals both appear, never two cards from one 8", "With Oops! All 6s (2 in 4 each): every scored 8 creates exactly one card", "Consumable slots full -> nothing created", "Description shows '1 in 4' twice (with Oops!: '2 in 4')"]
vanilla_effect_raw: ["{C:green}#1# in #2#{} chance for each", "played {C:attention}8{} to create a", "{C:tarot}Tarot{} card when scored", "{C:inactive}(Must have room)"]
